name: Fey Bodak Skulk

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

weaknesses.name: Radiant
weaknesses.details: ; a bodak skulk that takes radiant damage cannot weaken a target until the end of its next turn.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Agonizing Gaze
traits.details: each creature within the aura that makes a melee or a ranged attack against the bodak skulk takes 5 necrotic damage before the attack roll is made and takes a –2 penalty to the attack roll.

auras.name: Agonizing Gaze
auras.details: each creature within the aura that makes a melee or a ranged attack against the bodak skulk takes 5 necrotic damage before the attack roll is made and takes a –2 penalty to the attack roll.

hit.description: damage plus 2d6 necrotic damage, and the target is weakened until the end of the bodak skulk’s next turn

powers.name: Surprise Attack
powers.requirements: usable while the bodak skulk is hidden

effect.description: The bodak skulk makes a melee at-will attack that deals 2d8 extra damage.

hit.description: if the target is weakened, it drops to 0 hit points; otherwise, the target takes 1d6 + 6 necrotic damage and loses a healing surge

effect.description: The bodak skulk becomes invisible and gains insubstantial and phasing. It can do nothing but move in its spectral form, and it can return to its normal form as a free action.
The bodak skulk can alter its physical form to appear as an attractive humanoid of its size and any race or gender (see “Change Shape,” Monster Manual 2, page 216).
